component.name: SmartTwitchTV
component.summary: Watch Twitch with a remote or controller

description.p: A desktop build of SmartTwitchTV, the Twitch client made for TVs. It runs full screen and is driven entirely by a remote, a game controller or the keyboard, which makes it a good fit for living-room PCs, stream machines and Steam's Gaming Mode.

ul.li: Live streams, VODs, clips, games and followed channels
Live chat, picture-in-picture and up to four streams at once
Previews while browsing, quality selection and low-latency playback

description.p: This is an unofficial, community-made app with no affiliation with Twitch. The interface comes from the SmartTwitchTV project by Felipe de Leon (github.com/fgl27/SmartTwitchTV).
First desktop build: full TV mode with hls.js playback, gamepad support and a refreshed look.
